name: How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel varies based on the project's complexity and scope. A minor cosmetic update might take 1-2 weeks, while a complete gut and remodel, especially one involving layout changes or structural work, could take 3-6 weeks or even longer. Factors like material availability, permit processing (if required), and unexpected issues can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, keeping you informed every step of the way.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodels typically take 1-6 weeks depending on complexity, from minor updates to full gut renovations.
